description: Ranked breakdown for one dimension: pages, sources, countries, regions, cities, devices, browsers, goals, etc. dim must be one of the schema enum values. Optional filters: JSON array [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values OR within a dimension, AND across dimensions. Region uses country:region (e.g. US:CA). Source dimensions use session entry; visitors can overlap across source rows and must not be summed as a period total. viewsMetric labels views as sessions, pageviews, or events. Rows are sorted by primaryMetric from the response: views for path, hostname, entry_page, exit_page; visitors for all other dims — re-sorting on the other column disagrees with the dashboard. Read-only.

filters.description: Dashboard filters as JSON array, e.g. [{ "d": "country", "o": "is", "v": ["DE"] }]. Values within a dimension are OR'd; dimensions are AND'd. Region values are country:region (e.g. US:CA).

format.description: Output shape: table (default) or raw json.

name: get_breakdown
